payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the deep neural network models used in evaluation, including the Neural Image Captioning (NIC) model and the Show and Tell model, along with the metrics used for evaluation.

claims.text: The Neural Image Captioning (NIC) model is used for evaluation on the new corpus of Vietnamese image captioning.
The Show and Tell model is also evaluated using the same datasets and metrics as the NIC model.
Evaluation metrics used include BLEU, ROUGE, and CIDEr, which are standard in image captioning tasks.
